sections.title: SB01, W7L26 Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs)

keyTerms.definition: Turns data into noise.
Turns noise back into data.

recall.question: What do the three title words promise?
recall.answer: Denoising: remove noise. Diffusion: add noise gradually through a Markov chain. Probabilistic models: the reverse steps are distributions.

keyTerms.definition: The reverse parameterization (C06).

recall.question: What are the three algebraic results?
recall.answer: The closed form q(x_t | x_0), the posterior q(x_{t-1} | x_t, x_0) with coefficients, and the reverse parameterization.

keyTerms.definition: The network output: the predicted noise.
How this lesson treats the U-Net.

recall.question: What is the U-Net's job?
recall.answer: eps_hat(x_t, t): take a noisy input and timestep, predict the noise; the function inside every reverse step.

sections.title: SB04, W8L28 ELBO for DDPM: Part 1

keyTerms.definition: Into L_T, the middle KLs, and L_0.
0.7713 nats on the toy.

recall.question: What does part 1 set up?
recall.answer: The variational bound for the chain: the joint p(x_{0:T}), the approximate posterior, and the telescoping sum.

sections.title: SB05, W8L29 ELBO for DDPM: Part 2

keyTerms.definition: What each middle KL reduces to.
What W8L30 then drops.

recall.question: What does part 2 add?
recall.answer: Each middle KL reduces to a squared mean difference; the sum becomes the weighted noise-prediction objective.

sections.title: SB06, W8L30 Optimization of DDPM loss

keyTerms.definition: The training loss: the simplification, not the bound.
The toy mean over five pairs.

recall.question: What is the step from weighted ELBO to simplified loss?
recall.answer: Drop the coefficients, sample t uniformly, minimize ||eps - eps_hat||^2.

keyTerms.definition: Two forms of the bound coincide.
The VAE-ELBO reading, marked as such.

recall.question: What is the natural title-level reading?
recall.answer: The DDPM ELBO equals the standard VAE ELBO applied to the chain latents x_{1:T}.

keyTerms.definition: The per-example cost via the t sampler and direct noising.
The authored reference loop in C10.

recall.question: What is the training loop?
recall.answer: Sample x_0, sample t uniform, sample eps, form x_t, predict eps_hat, squared error, backprop.

keyTerms.definition: The per-sample inference cost.
The third toy sampling value.

recall.question: What does inference cost?
recall.answer: T network evaluations per sample, iterating the reverse Gaussian from x_T ~ N(0,1).
